title: Data coverage and repair
corpus: One venue, bounded recorded outage/reorg traces
metrics: Replay state hash, gap downtime, bytes and request cost
gate: No candidate while state is invalid

title: Compute scaling
metrics: Useful candidates before deadline per CPU-second; p50/p95/p99 age
gate: Identical decisions and bounded queues; improvement must exceed overhead

title: Conflict-aware selection
corpus: Disjoint pools, shared lender, shared payer, read/write and read/read
metrics: Foregone modeled surplus, component sizes and admitted set correctness
gate: Agreement with exhaustive small cases; measure heuristic gap for large components

title: Joint two-path capacity
corpus: Exact grid, path ordering, changed lender fees and partial fill rejections
metrics: Net benefit over best single path at equal total compute cost
gate: Debt closure and shared-state consistency for every selected point

title: Correlation falsification
corpus: Registered pairs, asynchronous timestamps and null/lag perturbations
metrics: Out-of-sample residuals, effective episodes, after-cost economics
gate: Unknown remains unknown; no promoted relation from in-sample correlation

title: Market-maker economics
corpus: One book and conservative queue/cancel/hedge variants
metrics: Fill-conditioned markouts, inventory drawdown and total PnL
gate: Full cost and loss accounting; no invented trade access

title: Useful service procurement
corpus: Same decoding/routing problem and independent validator
metrics: Useful correct output cost, latency, error and repeat demand design
gate: Do not count signed incorrect output or subsidized self-demand

title: Forward-shadow readiness
corpus: Recorded replay first; future read-only capture under a bounded explicit run budget
metrics: Useful coverage, invalidations, failure recovery and economic uncertainty
gate: No live enablement; promotion is separate future scope
